chapter: Complaints to Senator Eastland, FCC and WDSU
title: La Rocca's January 1955 letter to Senator Eastland
summary: The interviewer reads La Rocca's letter urging Eastland's committee to examine jazz history 'propaganda' and the New Orleans Jazz Club.

story.theme_name: Race and segregation in the jazz life
story.community_name: Segregation on the road and the bandstand

blocks.x: This is a letter headed Dominique James Nicola Rocca, 2218 Constant Street, New Orleans, Louisiana, 13, January the 9th, 1955. Senator Eastland of Mississippi, Washington, D.C. Honorable Senator Eastland, Hoping you may direct your committee attention to the propaganda that has been going on in New Orleans. Because wherever there is smoke, there must be fire. These people have given out history, read jazz music, as compiled by the Northern Coppetbaggers, NAACP through Bill Handy, trying to give the Negro culture into the music field. This thing was started by one Marshall Stearns, a young Jewish scholar not out of school, who wrote lies about me and my band, the original Dixieland jazz band, the first jazz band in the world, migrated to Chicago, 1916, New York City, Rosenweber's Cafe, 1917, recorded for the Victor Company, record released March 7, 1916. 17? I'm sorry. You caught me there. Let me erase that. I made a mistake that was March the 7th, 1917, sold all over the globe, and perpetuated long before these men who write on jazz was born. I thought it was in Russia only where this kind of propaganda could be used by station WDSU, New Orleans item WDSU radio. Your Honor, I always thought the airways were for the public, radio, television, for newspapers, or a public service, found by moral decency to tell the truth. These carpetbaggers are aided in New Orleans by Ms. Myra Menville and Dr. Sushan, who are having mixed bands brought to New Orleans and given concerts, which is a method that was started by the historians having colored and white mixed to play. These people are from the intelligentsia and should know the laws of the South. These people control the press because of their position in the social world. They are supposed to be historians and pass on to who started this music. This jazz club movement is nothing but to bring on integration between the poor white man and the colored race, as these parasites are already segregated from their own poor, their own, I'm sorry, segregated from their own white poor people. They have their social circles where no poor white trash, as they have the Negro call us poor people. Please do not think I am a crank, but this bears looking into you. Sincerely, yours.
